I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random: the ticket is PD-4821.

Hollis posted it in #central-team on Jun 9, saying the Eastbank receiving-door import for Marrow Agrisupply is attached to PD-4821. He also noted that the import file labels the doors E1/E2 while their booking sheet uses 01/02, and that had to be fixed before anyone reimports. Tobias is a member of #central-team, so he can see that message himself.
